question: Q-N-M2-D3
text: Fare per mile by month for pickups in the Airports service zone, 2024 vs 2023.
interpretation: Fare per mile by calendar month for pickups in the 'Airports' service zone, 2024 vs 2023.
assemble: SELECT calendar_month, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2023 THEN fare_per_mile END) AS fare_per_mile_2023, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2024 THEN fare_per_mile END) AS fare_per_mile_2024 FROM q WHERE trips > 0 GROUP BY calendar_month ORDER BY calendar_month
